user.title: HomeKit TV Remote
user.description: Pick the TV you already paired through the HomeKit Device integration. The name you give it becomes the entity names, for example Sony TV produces remote.sony_tv and media_player.sony_tv.

data_description.media_player_entity_id: Only TVs paired through the HomeKit Device integration are listed.
data_description.tv_name: Used for the device name and both entity IDs.

abort.no_homekit_tv: No paired TV found. Pair the TV through the HomeKit Device integration first, then add this one.
abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

init.title: HomeKit TV Remote
init.description: Changes take effect immediately. Press **Reload HomeKit Bridge** on the device page once you are finished, so Apple Home picks up the new list.

menu_option_descriptions.tv_inputs: Tick the inputs your TV reports, and test one before committing.
menu_option_descriptions.shortcut: Add an app or another integration's command as an input.
menu_option_descriptions.manage: Rename, reorder or remove what you have configured.
menu_option_descriptions.hap_commands: Every command remote.send_command accepts, on a drawn remote.

tv_inputs.title: TV inputs
tv_inputs.description:
These are the inputs your TV reports over HomeKit. Ticked ones appear in Apple Home, in the Home Assistant source list, and in the ⓘ Info button cycle.

Not sure which is which? Pick one under **Test** and submit — the TV switches to it and this form stays open. Nothing is saved while testing.

data.test_input: Test — switch the TV to this now

data_description.sources: Nothing to type: the names and their HomeKit identifiers are read from the TV itself.
data_description.test_input: Leave empty to save your selection instead.

shortcut.title: Add a shortcut
shortcut.description:
A shortcut is an input that drives another integration — launching Netflix on an Apple TV, or sending a CEC command through a vendor remote.

Tick **Test** to fire it once without saving.

data.name: Name
data.tv_source: Switch TV to this input first

data_description.name: Shown in Apple Home and in the Home Assistant source list.
data_description.target: The media player or remote entity that carries out the action.
data_description.action: An app name for a media player, or a command name for a remote. The right service is chosen automatically: if the app name appears in that entity's own source list it is selected as a source, otherwise it is played as media.
data_description.tv_source: Optional. Use it when the TV also has to change input first, for example to the Apple TV's HDMI port.
data_description.test: Sends it now and leaves the form open. Untick and submit to save.

hap_commands.title: HAP commands

manage.title: Manage saved inputs
manage.description: Everything you have configured, in cycle order.

menu_option_descriptions.rename: Change the label only — what the input does stays the same.
menu_option_descriptions.reorder: Move one input up or down in the ⓘ cycle.
menu_option_descriptions.remove: Delete inputs you no longer want.

rename.title: Rename an input
rename.description:
Pick an input and give it a new name. Only the label changes — the TV input it switches to, or the entity it drives, stays exactly as it was, and so does its place in the cycle.

The form comes back after each rename, so you can do several.

data_description.new_name: This is what appears in Apple Home and in the source list.

reorder.title: Change the order
reorder.description: This is the order the ⓘ Info button and the Next input button step through. Move one input at a time — the list is renumbered each time, so you can keep going until it reads the way you want.

data_description.target_input: Numbered in the current cycle order.

remove.title: Remove inputs
remove.description: Tick anything you want to delete. Nothing is ticked to begin with, so submitting as-is changes nothing.

manual.title: Manual
manual.description:
The full manual covers every field, every command, worked examples for Apple TV and other integrations, and troubleshooting.

**[Open the HomeKit TV Remote manual]({url})**

The same link is behind the ? icon in any of these dialogs, and under Documentation in the integration's ⋮ menu.

error.name_taken: You already have an input with that name.
error.action_required: Enter the app name or command to send.
error.test_sent: Sent. If the TV did what you expected, clear Test and submit to save.
error.test_failed: That could not be sent. Check the Home Assistant log for the reason.
error.renamed: Renamed. Pick another input to rename, or close this dialog.
error.reordered: Moved. The list below is renumbered — move another, or close this dialog.

abort.no_sources: Your TV is not reporting any inputs. Make sure it is switched on and reachable, then try again.
abort.no_inputs: Nothing is configured yet. Add TV inputs or a shortcut first.
abort.nothing_to_reorder: You need at least two saved inputs before order means anything.
